facts.text: The hotel is at 700 Fifth Avenue at 55th Street, New York.
facts.excerpt: The Peninsula New York, 700 Fifth Avenue at 55th Street, New York, NY 10019, USA

facts.text: The hotel has convenient access to Rockefeller Center, Fifth Avenue shopping, museums and Broadway theaters.
facts.excerpt: elegant public areas, and convenient access to Rockefeller Center, premier Fifth Avenue shopping, acclaimed museums, and the legendary theaters of Broadway.

facts.text: A property-wide refurbishment led by New York City-based Bill Rooney Studio began in January 2024.
facts.excerpt: Led by the award-winning New York City-based Bill Rooney Studio, the property-wide refurbishment, which commenced in January 2024, includes the hotel’s Lobby, Reception, Palm Court, and the reimagined rooftop lounge, Pen Top.

facts.text: The refurbishment included the Lobby, Reception, Palm Court and the reimagined rooftop lounge, Pen Top.
facts.excerpt: includes the hotel’s Lobby, Reception, Palm Court, and the reimagined rooftop lounge, Pen Top.

facts.text: Rooms have newly reimagined interiors and overlook Fifth Avenue or the city.
facts.excerpt: Newly reimagined interiors bring the polish of a private Manhattan residence to rooms overlooking Fifth Avenue or the city that never sleeps.

facts.text: The Grand Suite occupies a 20th-floor corner overlooking Fifth Avenue with views of Central Park.
facts.excerpt: The stately renovated Grand Suite occupies a 20th floor corner location of the hotel overlooking Fifth Avenue with views of Central Park.

facts.text: Deluxe Suites are one-bedroom corner suites with Fifth Avenue views, a decorative fireplace and a dining table.
facts.excerpt: Bask in glorious views of Fifth Avenue from these newly renovated one-bedroom corner suites. A decorative fireplace, dining table and luxurious furnishings create the grandeur and intimacy of a New York apartment.

facts.text: Deluxe Rooms have double-glazed windows.
facts.excerpt: The double-glazed windows ensure every guest enjoys a peaceful stay.

facts.text: Superior Rooms have interior courtyard views.
facts.excerpt: The interior courtyard views are ideal for those seeking a quiet and cosy retreat.

facts.text: Guests staying in a suite can use a chauffeur-driven MINI Cooper S Clubman as a complimentary amenity.
facts.excerpt: the chauffeur-driven MINI Cooper S Clubman vehicles are available as a complimentary amenity for guests staying in a suite. Enjoy access to the high-performance head-turners

facts.text: A Peninsula Edition BMW house car is available based on availability.
facts.excerpt: Make use of a bespoke Peninsula Edition BMW house car based on availability

facts.text: Clement Restaurant serves American fare across three themed rooms.
facts.excerpt: Clement Restaurant brings people together across three distinct themed rooms, offering notable American fare with an approachable Midtown sensibility.

facts.text: Clement was designed by Yabu Pushelberg.
facts.excerpt: Designed by leading international firm Yabu Pushelberg, Clement’s overall design scheme

facts.text: Clement's Color Room has a sixty-foot-long hand-etched mural of a jungle over New York buildings, titled Wild New York.
facts.excerpt: Guests dine surrounded by a sixty-foot-long, hand-etched jungle growing over the buildings of New York, entitled “Wild New York.”

facts.text: Clement serves a Saturday brunch and a Sunday Brunch Buffet.
facts.excerpt: Weekends come alive with a vibrant brunch scene on Saturdays and Sundays.

facts.text: Pen Top is the hotel's rooftop bar and terrace.
facts.excerpt: Rooftop Bar and Terrace

facts.text: The Gotham Lounge offers classic cocktails and live piano.
facts.excerpt: Classic cocktails, live piano and a New York moment

facts.text: Clement Bar is a cocktail bar described as having speakeasy glamour and rare bottles.
facts.excerpt: Speakeasy glamour, rare bottles and classic form

facts.text: In-room dining is available 24 hours.
facts.excerpt: The diverse 24-hour In-room Dining menu is ideal for time-zone-hopping travellers

facts.text: The pool has floor-to-ceiling teak columns and a black tile floor, and poolside dining is available.
facts.excerpt: The serene pool at The Peninsula New York boasts sleek décor that features striking floor-to-ceiling teak columns set against a cool black tile floor. Poolside dining is also available

facts.text: The spa has 11 treatment rooms including a Private Spa Suite, men's and women's relaxation lounges and a tea lounge.
facts.excerpt: The Spa features a stunning collection of 11 treatment rooms including a spacious Private Spa Suite, men’s and women’s private relaxation lounges, a tea lounge, and changing rooms with luxurious heat experiences.

facts.text: The spa's aromatherapy steam room, sauna, ice fountain and experience shower are set against a 24-karat gold Bisazza mosaic.
facts.excerpt: An aromatherapy steam room, sauna, ice fountain and “experience” shower are set against a backdrop of 24 karat gold mosaic by Bisazza.

facts.text: The spa offers facials by Biologique Recherche.
facts.excerpt: try one of the popular facials by the French luxury skincare line Biologique Recherche

facts.text: The Private Spa Suite has side-by-side treatments, a private steam shower and a double whirlpool bath.
facts.excerpt: Relax and rejuvenate with pampering side-by-side treatments before enjoying the luxurious private steam shower and double whirlpool bath.

facts.text: The spa is Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star rated.
facts.excerpt: The Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star Peninsula Spa & Wellness Center

facts.text: Hotel guests receive complimentary access to the pool and fitness center.
facts.excerpt: Hotel guests receive complimentary access to the above facilities during their stay.

facts.text: The fitness center has bamboo floors, teak accents and Manhattan skyline views.
facts.excerpt: The distinctive bamboo floors, teak accents and natural ambient lighting combine perfectly to highlight the spectacular Manhattan skyline views.

facts.text: The hair salon offers services for special events and weddings, and in-room.
facts.excerpt: Services are available for special events and weddings, and are also available in-room.

facts.text: Guests must be 18 or older to use the fitness facility.
facts.excerpt: Guests must be 18 years of age or older in order to utilise the fitness facility.

facts.text: Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult at the pool.
facts.excerpt: Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult.

facts.text: The hotel offers dedicated children's amenities.
facts.excerpt: Whether it be the spacious rooms, dedicated children’s amenities or range of  entertainment options, The Peninsula will ensure a memorable stay for the whole family.

facts.text: The hotel is 17 miles from JFK, 10 miles from LaGuardia and 15 miles from Newark.
facts.excerpt: 17 miles (28 km) from John F. Kennedy / 10 miles (15 km) from LaGuardia / 15 miles (25 km) from Newark

facts.text: Peninsula Time allows arrival as early as 6am and departure as late as 10pm, complimentary.
facts.excerpt: With Peninsula Time, enjoy arrival as early as 6am and stay through 10pm at every Peninsula hotel worldwide and always with our compliments.

facts.text: The hotel is a Forbes Travel Guide Five Star hotel.
facts.excerpt: the Forbes Travel Guide Five Star hotel features newly refurbished rooms

facts.text: The hotel is steps from Central Park.
facts.excerpt: Steps from Central Park, the Forbes Travel Guide Five Star hotel

facts.text: The Gotham Lounge serves afternoon tea.
facts.excerpt: enjoy Gotham Lounge’s legendary Afternoon Tea

facts.text: The swimming pool is glass-enclosed.
facts.excerpt: Take a relaxing dip in The Peninsula New York’s glass-enclosed swimming pool

facts.text: The fitness center has Technogym equipment and a sunlit studio with complimentary daily group classes.
facts.excerpt: A sun-lit fitness studio offers complimentary daily group classes.

contradictions.note: p8 says guests must be 18+ to use the spa, but later says 18+ unless accompanied by a parent or guardian

sources.excerpt: Guests must be 18 years of age or older in order to utilize The Spa and receive treatments.
Guests must be 18 years of age or older to use The Spa, unless accompanied by a parent or guardian.
